summary.text: Rob Beiswenger represents Idaho House District 8, Seat A, according to the Idaho Legislature's 2026 membership directory, which says Beiswenger lives in Horseshoe Bend.

paragraphs.text: The directory biography says Beiswenger was born and raised in Huntingdon Valley, Pennsylvania, and graduated from Penn State University in political science.
It lists Beiswenger as a former director of the Indiana Right to Work Committee and co-founder of Collaborative Behavior Solutions in Indianapolis, and as employed at Money Metals Exchange in Eagle.

sources.title: Idaho House of Representatives membership directory (2026 session)
